scripts.clean: rm -rfv dist *.tsbuildinfo wasm wasm-parallel package penumbra-zone-*.tgz
scripts.compile: cd crate && wasm-pack build --no-pack --target bundler --out-name index --out-dir ../wasm
scripts.compile:parallel: cd crate && RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+atomics,+bulk-memory,+mutable-globals,+simd128 -C link-arg=--max-memory=4294967296' cargo +nightly build --lib --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features parallel -Z build-std=panic_abort,std && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir ../wasm-parallel --out-name index ./target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/penumbra_wasm.wasm
scripts.compile:bundler: cd crate && wasm-pack build --no-pack --target bundler --out-name index --out-dir ../wasm
scripts.lint:rust: cd crate && cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --tests -- -D warnings
